test_std_exception: test the pybind11 module to verify C++ standard exceptions propagate as Python RuntimeError
test_cross_module_exceptions: test cross-module exception handling to verify RuntimeError and ValueError propagate across pybind11 modules
test_custom_exceptions: test custom pybind11 exception types like MyException and MyException5 for translation and subclassing
test_nested_throws: test nested C++ to Python to C++ exception handling using try_catch with custom exception types
test_python_call_in_catch: test that Python calls inside C++ destructors execute correctly during exception handling
